title: Melinda French Gates Almost Quit Microsoft At 25. Now She Has A Simple Rule for Giving Feedback Without L - Benzinga
summary: Melinda French Gates advocates for thoughtful communication, reflected in her 48-hour rule before addressing difficult issues, aiming to provide clear, kind feedback for growth. This approach, stemming from her time at Microsoft, has shaped her leadership style and influenced her philanthropic endeavors.
sentiment_reason: The 48-hour rule represents a positive leadership philosophy that encourages thoughtful dialogue and constructive criticism, fostering personal and professional growth.
